_comment: Per-container-type model + effort defaults. Layered like versions.env: this tracked file is the base, and an untracked ~/.research-sandbox/model-defaults.json overrides it PER KEY (a partial override file is fine — only the types it names are replaced). Every type resolves independently; there is no inheritance between types. The four project types are also overridable per-invocation at project create, box add, and the dev card; `reviewer` (the ephemeral dev-lane reviewer) has no per-invocation knob — it is read live at each review run and edited from Sandboxes → Infrastructure → Reviewer (rscore.model_default_set writes the override); `referee`, `analyst` and `surveyor` are set there too, frozen into each researcher-subagents project at create, and changed per project in its ⚙ Agents box.
_referee: The independent referee of a finding in a researcher-subagents project (rs-memory referee, Claude). Sonnet at high effort was measured adequate on 2026-11-22: it caught a planted overreach for about $0.04 per finding (Opus at high: about $0.11). Frozen into those projects' record at create; set here from Sandboxes → Infrastructure → Referee, and per project in its ⚙ Agents box.
_analyst: The analyst helper a researcher-subagents project's agent launches for one analysis, in parallel (Claude's analyst subagent). Sonnet at high effort is the setting the research flow's analysis workers use, measured adequate and about 15 times cheaper than max on the same analysis. Frozen into those projects' record at create; set here from Sandboxes → Infrastructure → Analyst, and per project in its ⚙ Agents box (pi's analyst is set there only, in pi's own provider/model form).
_surveyor: The surveyor helper a researcher-subagents project's agent launches for one web survey question (Claude's surveyor subagent). Sonnet at high effort, as the analyst. Frozen into those projects' record at create; set here from Sandboxes → Infrastructure → Surveyor, and per project in its ⚙ Agents box.
